-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #8 - Function talkevent6_1
function talkevent6_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(369.00, 340.00, 83.34)
	RotCamera(0.01, 1.41, 12.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1481, 365.00, 345.00, 30, 0, FALSE, 1, 28)
	CreateObject(1, 1036, 371.00, 339.00, 130, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(2, 1036, 353.00, 362.00, 30, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(3, 1036, 382.00, 366.00, 235, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(4, 10014, 432.00, 391.00, 192, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM036.ogg")
	PlayCameraNoWait("tutorial_01_8.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 8)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent6_1)
